summary.intent: Resume phase 43 (fuse-write-durability) branch, run a CodeRabbit CLI review, verify and fix all outstanding critical findings from the existing 43-REVIEW.md, run a /simplify quality pass, capture deferred items as todos, and ship the PR.
summary.outcome: All 8 review criticals resolved in code (CR-03 TEE-key fallback and CR-04 prepare-before-journal mutation ordering fixed; 6 others confirmed already fixed by earlier commits). Three simplify cleanups applied and committed. Six deferred refactor/perf items captured as structured GSD todos. All three new commits pushed to remote. Ship workflow initiated with verification doc updated to passed.

repo: Phase 43 maps to branch `feat/fuse-write-durability` and directory `.planning/phases/43-fuse-write-durability/`; merge-base against main is `158addccac4f182b2bd7221f1ee80cdece393928`.

CI gates on `cargo check/test --workspace` for both `--features winfsp` and `--features fuse` (ci.yml:557-605) but does NOT run `cargo fmt` or `cargo clippy` — rustfmt issues are repo-wide pre-existing style, running fmt would produce a noisy repo-wide diff.
winfsp code is not locally compilable on macOS; the winfsp path of every fuse edit must be verified by inspection and then validated by CI's winfsp gate.
Phase 42 was squash-merged (PR #485, 2026-06-13); its commits appear in the branch history but produce zero net diff against `origin/main`, so the PR diff is cleanly phase-43-only.
The local `main` ref can be stale after another branch is squash-merged; always diff against `origin/main` (or use `git merge-base`) to compute true PR scope.
Pre-push hooks run an Entire CLI checkpoint sync before pushing; pre-commit hooks run markdownlint and prettier. `.planning/` is excluded from markdownlint.

Commit exit-code 0 from a background bash task is not reliable — git can fail at the signing step after the pre-commit hooks pass and still exit 0 in certain pipeline configurations; always verify HEAD separately.
1Password SSH signer is prone to wedging after a failed attempt ('failed to fill whole buffer') and requires quitting and relaunching the 1Password app to recover.

code.finding: CR-03 primary site: mkdir journal entry fell back to `encrypted_ipns_for_tee` (TEE-wrapped key) in the user-key field on `wrap_key` failure, making the journal entry irreplayable with the user's private key. Fixed by logging a warning and journaling an empty string (park-on-replay) instead.
CR-03 second site: same TEE-key fallback in upload journal entry construction. Fixed identically — warn and journal empty string.

CR-04: inode.kind mutation (@765), pending_content mutation (@782), and queue_publish fire (@794) all occurred before `journal.put`. A journal fsync failure left mutated in-memory state with no rollback, and the debounced publisher could emit parent metadata for a write the OS was told failed. Fixed by deferring all three mutations until after the journal commit.

CR-03 hardening + `wrap_key` path inconsistency: `cipherbox_crypto::wrap_key` used at lines 148/152/886 while the rest of the file uses `cipherbox_crypto::ecies::wrap_key` — they resolve to the same function but the inconsistency could cause a latent compile error if the winfsp path ever diverges. Normalized to `ecies::wrap_key` throughout.

Six IPNS-key journal wrap sites (parent key ×4 at write_ops:523, read_ops:816, windows:148, windows:886 and file key ×2 at read_ops:841, windows:918) silently fell back to empty string on wrap failure — same silent-degradation class as CR-03 but to empty rather than TEE key. All six now warn-and-park.

Replay first-publish detection uses case-sensitive `e.to_lowercase().contains("not found")` from `coordinator.resolve_sequence`; a reworded error message silently flips the seq-0 vs transient-error branch. Deferred: needs `resolve_sequence` to return `Result<Option<u64>>` or a typed `NotFound` variant.
Added `JournalOp::created_at_ms()` accessor to eliminate duplicated per-variant `sort_by_key` match expressions in `ordered_for_replay`. Simplify finding A.

Dead `journal_entry_id` field in fuser `UploadSpawnParams` — populated but only ever read as `let _` to suppress an unused warning. Removed field, populate, destructure, and suppressor. Simplify finding B.

workflow: CodeRabbit CLI review can be scoped to a phase diff by passing the merge-base commit as the base; avoids reviewing unrelated history.
Dispatching parallel read-only verification agents (one per critical finding) is effective for cross-checking a large set of documented issues against current code without bloating the main context.

Commit messages that claim fixes (e.g. 'close CR-04/08/07') cannot be trusted at face value — CodeRabbit independently re-found CR-03 live in code despite a fix commit existing. Always verify against current code.

The `fix-before-mutate` pattern (defer all in-memory state mutations until after the durable journal commit) is cleaner than snapshot-and-rollback when there is no rollback API for side effects like `queue_publish`.
For a cleanup pass (/simplify), adding a new crate dependency to implement a helper is out of scope — note the footgun and defer; don't introduce dep-creep.
When parallel subagents edit different files in the same directory, assign each agent a non-overlapping file set to avoid conflicts; fold edits to shared files into the main context.
After 1Password SSH signer failure, staged changes survive — only the signing step needs to be retried, not re-staging.

friction: 1Password SSH signer wedged twice with 'failed to fill whole buffer' during commit signing, requiring full app restart to recover; two retries were lost before the commit landed.

Background bash task exit code 0 was misleading — git commit failed at the signing step after pre-commit hooks passed, but the task reported success. HEAD must be checked independently to confirm a commit actually landed.
Local `main` ref was stale (didn't reflect phase 42's squash merge), causing an initial over-count of the PR diff scope that had to be corrected by diffing against `origin/main`.
winfsp code is not compilable on macOS, so all Windows-path edits had to be verified by visual inspection against the compile-checked fuser path, with CI as the only real compiler gate.
open_items: Consolidate the ~150 lines of near-identical fuser↔winfsp upload + mkdir journal-entry construction and UploadSpawnParams/spawn machinery into shared CipherBoxFS methods in `crates/fuse/src/lib.rs` — security-sensitive (D-04 fsync-before-ack and D-05 plaintext-handling ordering must be preserved), requires winfsp CI gate.

Replace empty-string sentinel for missing/unwrappable journal IPNS keys with `Option<String>` uniformly and add a `wrap_ipns_key_for_journal` helper — `parent_ipns_key_hex` uses sentinel while `file_ipns_key_hex` already uses Option, inconsistent within one struct.

Extract a shared journal-dir path + DEFAULT_MAX_RETRIES constant — the path `<data_local_dir>/cipherbox/cb-journal` and retry count `5` are triplicated across `apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/fuse/mod.rs`, `apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/fuse/windows/mod.rs`, and `apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/commands/sync.rs`; a mismatch would silently break crash recovery.

Have `replay_upload_entry` in `crates/fuse/src/lib.rs` delegate to `operations::publish_file_metadata` and extract a `cas_publish_parent` helper shared by replay and both live mkdir paths — currently re-inlines ~110 lines duplicated across three call sites.

Memoize `resolve_folder_key` during `replay_for_vault` in `crates/fuse/src/lib.rs` — currently re-walks the vault tree from root for every replayed entry; mount-time replay latency is super-linear when multiple queued entries share a parent folder.

Replace `e.to_lowercase().contains("not found")` in `crates/fuse/src/lib.rs:1394-1404` replay first-publish detection with a typed `Result<Option<u64>>` or `NotFound` variant from `coordinator.resolve_sequence` — a reworded error silently flips the branch.
No unit test covers the CR-04 invariant ('prepare-failure leaves no partial in-memory state'); hard to force a `journal.put` failure in a test but the behavior is correctness-critical.
